composition: Both repositories are byte-identical. The Apple-only transactSitePin uses the existing private transaction driver. The public transact, private transaction driver, write and encode retain their prior implementation.

The private atomic helper adds an optional pin-only rename callback after didPublish. After encoding, temp creation, write, file sync, close and before_rename, the pin lease checks retirement and calls rename under the same lock. didPublish, after_rename, directory fsync and temporary cleanup run outside the lease.
A retirement veto unwinds the temporary write without marking the repository unavailable. Other pin publication failures preserve the normal transaction quarantine behavior.

The existing Apple addPhoto(admit:) still checks admission at publication entry and uses the baseline photo creation, publication marker and cleanup. Ordinary rename/link selection and Android addPhoto/attachPhoto and queue code retain their existing semantics.
WorkspaceModel keeps the early lease check and selects the pin entry point only for a SitePinEdit. The save chain, project restoration and accessible location row retain their existing behavior.
